records.subject: spec-guard-release-artifact
evidence: result:the package was built from the v0.27.0 tag with git archive of .claude-plugin and plugins/spec-guard plus ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json, the method that rebuilt v0.24.0 file-for-file identical to its published asset
result:release-package.py validated the artifact directory before archiving and again after extracting the archive; the archive contains no AppleDouble entries
result:the locally built archive and the downloaded published GitHub asset both have SHA-256 6d8f3881af57f8718a423b397656d3f54f72cae319779e0acc43642f854ed4cc, matching the digest GitHub reports

content:the package contains locks/local-ticket-ledger/package.json and package-lock.json (269 locked packages, each with a sha512 integrity) and hooks/local_ledger_runtime.py installs with npm ci --ignore-scripts
result:the required GitHub Actions checks validate (ubuntu-latest) and validate (macos-latest) passed on be1eaba, the release pull request head whose tree is identical to the tagged merge commit
